title: Preparation of Proteins from Whole Body Larval Zebrafish Tissue for Proteomics
author: Abigail Henke
materials: Lysis Buffer (0.05M Tris-HCl, 0.05M DTT, Protease Inhibitors, 10mL)

Lysis Buffer (0.05M Tris-HCl, 0.05M DTT, Protease Inhibitors, 10mL, enough to prepare 24 samples) Obtain a clean 15mL polypropylene falcon tube, 10mL graduated cylinder, Tris-HCl Stock , Dithiothreitol (DTT) Stock aliquot, Roche cOmplete Protease Inhibitor Tablet (04693116001), an ultrapure water source, and 1000μL pipette and appropriate tips. Record the manufacturer, lot number, date opened, and date of expiration for all reagents. Measure out the following and add to the 15mL falcon tube: 5 mL of 0.1M Tris-HCl stock reagent 500 µL of DTT Stock, thawed in the dark 1 Tablet of Roche cOmplete Protease Inhibitor. Record source and purity of ultrapure water. Measure 10 mL of ultrapure water using the graduated cylinder and add to the tube. Cap and mix vigorously with a vortex to dissolve. Place solution On ice , do not store past 24hrs. Label: Lysis Buffer Working Solution, [Initials], date of preparation, date of expiration (24hr from preparation date).

Obtain 30kD Amicon Centrifugal filter units, microcentrifuge, thermomixer fitting 24 samples, ultrapure water source, ice bucket with ice, 1000-, 200-, 100-, 20-, and 10μL pipettes and appropriate tips, 15mL falcon tube, 1.5mL lo bind microcentrifuge tube, sequencing grade modified porcine trypsin (Promega, frozen, 5-20ug, cat#V5113), prepared DOC Solution , prepared DTT stock , prepared IAA working solution , prepared priming solution , prepared UA buffer , prepared NaCl solution , prepared TFA Buffer , and prepared ABC buffer. Preheat thermomixer to 50 °C .

Cap collection tubes and place into the pre-warmed Speed-Vap (the hole in the lid where the filter tip was previously placed will allow solvent evaporation). Run the Speed-Vap in 5-10 minute intervals closely monitoring the volume of each sample until each is reduced from 150μL to a final volume of 5-10μL. Remove samples from speed-vap and turn off apparatus. If samples are accidentally completely dried, add 30μL of Formic Acid Solution to each dried out tube and place on a thermomixer for 00:30:00 at 1000 rpm, 30 °C, to resuspend protein in solution. Proceed with following step.

steps.title: Prepare 1X PBS (1L)
steps.instruction: Prepare 1L of Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS) by dissolving reagents in ultrapure water and adjusting pH.

substeps.instruction: Add 8.0 g NaCl, 0.200 g KCl, 1.44 g Na2HPO4, and 0.245 g KH2PO4 to a 1L glass media bottle.
Add 900 mL of ultrapure water and mix to dissolve.
Adjust pH to 7.4 ± 0.1 using 1M HCl or 1M NaOH.
Bring final volume to 1000 mL with ultrapure water.
Label and store at ambient room temperature (expiration 2 years).

steps.title: Prepare 0.1M Tris-HCl Stock (50mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare 50mL of Tris-HCl stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.788 g Tris-HCl to a 100mL glass media bottle.
Add 40 mL of ultrapure water and mix to dissolve.
Adjust pH to 7.8 ± 0.1 using 1M HCl or 1M NaOH.
Bring final volume to 50 mL with ultrapure water.
Label and store at ambient room temperature (expiration 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare 1M DTT Stock (10mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1M Dithiothreitol (DTT) stock and aliquot for storage.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5425 g DTT to a 15mL polypropylene falcon tube.
Add 10 mL of ultrapure water and mix to dissolve.
Aliquot 600 µL into 16 individual 1.5mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Label and store in the dark at -80°C (expiration 3 months).
Thaw aliquots by wrapping in tinfoil and allowing to reach ambient room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare 10% SDS Stock (10mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10% Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate (SDS) stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 g SDS to a 15mL polypropylene falcon tube.
Bring volume up to 10 mL with ultrapure water.
Mix gently with a vortex to dissolve, avoiding frothing (heat below boiling point if necessary).
Allow to return to ambient room temperature; do not place on ice.
Label and store at room temperature (expiration 6 months).

steps.title: Collect and Snap-Freeze Larval Zebrafish
steps.instruction: Collect 25 pooled larval zebrafish per sample and snap-freeze them in liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Place larval fish in an ice bucket for 5 minutes to slow swimming speeds.
Collect fish using a disposable dropper pipette and place in a 1.5mL lo-bind tube.
Cap and place on ice until fish pellet at the bottom.
Remove as much water as possible using a dropper pipette and a 200µL pipette (releasing plunger slowly at the bottom of the pellet).
Gently lower the tube into liquid nitrogen using forceps to snap-freeze.
Store samples between -20°C and -80°C until extraction.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Samples for Extraction
steps.instruction: Set up the lab environment and thaw tissue samples.

substeps.instruction: Cool benchtop centrifuge to 4°C and set heat block to 90°C.
Thaw collected tissue samples on wet ice.
Place lysis buffer on ice.

steps.title: Wash Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Wash the thawed tissue pellets to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples with 500 µL 1X PBS.
Centrifuge for 10 seconds at 4°C (quick spin).
Gently pipette off supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Repeat the wash step and remove as much supernatant as possible.
Return samples to ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue with Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Perform a 1:20 dilution of tissue with Lysis Buffer and homogenize.

substeps.instruction: Tare balance with an empty 2mL lo-bind tube and record the approximate mass of protein samples.
Add Lysis Buffer based on the formula: Volume (µL) = wet weight (mg) × 20. If total volume is below 200µL, add buffer to reach a final volume of 200µL.
Clean Scilogex homogenizer with 70% ethanol.
Place probe 1-2mm from the bottom of the tube and homogenize on level 4 speed for 30 seconds, moving the probe up and down.
Promptly return samples to ice.
Rinse probe with ultrapure water, spray with 70% ethanol, and wipe with a Kimwipe between samples.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Use SDS, heat, and sonication to extract proteins from the homogenized tissue.

substeps.instruction: Add 10% SDS stock to each tube to reach a final concentration of 2% (Volume SDS = [Volume lysis buffer × 2] ÷ 10). Do not place on ice.
Heat samples in a 90°C heat block for 5 minutes with a weighted top.
Sonicate samples: 15-second bursts with 15-second delays for a total of 1 minute at 60Hz, with the probe 1-2mm below the surface.
Return samples to 90°C heat block for 5 minutes, then cool for 15 minutes at ambient room temperature.
Centrifuge samples at 14,000 rpm, 4°C for 45 minutes.
Return to ice and pipette off the supernatant into a labeled 1.5mL lo-bind tube, avoiding the dark pellet.

steps.title: Optional: Increase Protein Yield
steps.instruction: Perform additional extraction on the un-lysed pellet to maximize yield.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet with 96 µL Lysis Buffer and 24 µL of 10% SDS stock; vortex well.
Heat in a 90°C heat block for 5 minutes, then cool for 15 minutes at ambient room temperature.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm, 4°C for 15 minutes.
Pipette off supernatant and add to the labeled protein tube.
Store extracted protein at -80°C or proceed to BCA quantitation.

steps.title: Prepare ABC Buffer (100mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare 50mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (ABC) buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.9764 g ABC to a 100mL media bottle.
Add 400 mL of ultrapure water and mix to dissolve.
Adjust pH to 8.5 ± 0.1 using 1M HCl or 1M NaOH.
Bring final volume to 500 mL with ultrapure water.
Label and store at ambient room temperature (expiration 2 years).

steps.title: Prepare Urea (UA) Buffer (25mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare UA Buffer (0.01M Tris-HCl, 2M Urea, pH 8.5).

substeps.instruction: Add 3.003 g Urea and 2.5 mL of 0.1M Tris-HCl stock to a 50mL polypropylene falcon tube.
Add 15 mL of ultrapure water and vortex vigorously to dissolve (heat gently if needed; do not place on ice).
Adjust pH to 8.5 ± 0.1 using 1M HCl or 1M NaOH.
Bring final volume to 25 mL with ultrapure water.
Label and store at room temperature (expiration 24 hours).

steps.title: Prepare IAA Stock and Working Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Iodoacetamide (IAA) stock and the subsequent working buffer.

substeps.instruction: Stock: Add 0.18496 g IAA to 1 mL UA buffer in a 1.5mL tube; vortex.
Aliquot stock into 0.6mL tubes (60 µL each) and store at -80°C in the dark (expiration 1 year).
Working Buffer: Thaw an aliquot in foil; add 50 µL IAA Stock to 950 µL UA buffer; vortex.
Wrap in foil and store at ambient room temperature (expiration 24 hours).

steps.title: Prepare Priming Solution (50mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50:50 Methanol:Water solution.

substeps.instruction: Mix 25 mL Methanol and 25 mL ultrapure water in a 50mL falcon tube.
Label and store at ambient room temperature (expiration 1 year).

steps.title: Prepare 1% DOC Solution (10mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare Sodium Deoxycholate (DOC) solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 g DOC to 9 mL ultrapure water in a 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube; mix to dissolve.
Add 1 mL Tris-HCl Stock and vortex.
Aliquot into 1.5mL tubes (1 mL each) and store at -80°C in the dark (expiration 6 months).
Thaw aliquots in tinfoil before use.

steps.title: Prepare 5% TFA Buffer (20mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare Trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) buffer inside a ventilation hood.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL TFA from a glass ampule into a 100mL glass media bottle.
Add 19 mL of ultrapure water and mix.
Label and store in an acid storage cabinet at ambient room temperature (expiration 1 year).

steps.title: Filter Unit Preparation and Priming
steps.instruction: Prepare and prime 30kD Amicon Centrifugal filter units.

substeps.instruction: Thaw samples and Trypsin on wet ice.
Pipette 200 µL ultrapure water into labeled filter units and spin at 14,000 x g, 25°C for 15 minutes to check for leaks.
Pipette 200 µL Priming Solution into each unit and spin at 14,000 x g, 25°C for 15 minutes.
Decant remaining solution without letting filters dry out.

steps.title: Protein Loading and Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Load protein and perform buffer exchange using UA and ABC buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µg of protein sample and 200 µL UA buffer to each filter unit; mix by pipetting 15-20 times.
Spin at 14,000 x g, 25°C for 30 minutes (liquid should reach ~40µL).
Add 100 µL ABC Buffer and spin at 14,000 rpm, 25°C for 20 minutes (liquid should reach 20-50µL).
Repeat the ABC buffer wash and discard eluate.

steps.title: Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Reduce and alkylate proteins using DTT and IAA.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL DTT stock to each unit; shake at 600 rpm for 1 minute and incubate in the dark at 50°C for 30 minutes.
Add 11 µL IAA Working Buffer; shake at 600 rpm for 1 minute and incubate in the dark at 50°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform protein digestion using Trypsin and DOC solution.

substeps.instruction: Wash filter units with 100mL ABC buffer; spin at 14,000 x g, 25°C for 30 minutes and discard eluate.
Spin again at 14,000 x g, 25°C for 20 minutes.
Add ~30 µL DOC Solution (to reach total volume of 60µL) and 3 µL Trypsin (1µg, 1:50 ratio).
Shake at 600 rpm for 1 minute and incubate at 37°C for 15 hours in a thermomixer with a heated top.
Add 1.5 µL Trypsin, mix at 600 rpm for 1 minute, and incubate at 37°C for 3 hours.

steps.title: Sample Recovery and Acidification
steps.instruction: Recover digested peptides and acidify the samples.

substeps.instruction: Spin samples at 14,000 rpm, 25°C for 7 minutes.
Add 100 µL NaCl solution and mix at 600 rpm for 15 minutes.
Invert filters into a clean collection tube and collect supernatant by spinning at 4,000 x g, 25°C for 5 minutes.
Acidify by adding 80 µL 5% TFA Solution (final concentration 2% TFA) and vortex.
Spin at 4,000 rpm, 25°C for 5 minutes; transfer supernatant to 1.5mL lo-bind tubes and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Desalting Solutions (A-D)
steps.instruction: Prepare the four solutions required for peptide desalting.

substeps.instruction: Solution A: 5 mL HPLC-grade Methanol.
Solution B: 3 mL HPLC-grade acetonitrile, 2 mL HPLC-grade water, and 5 µL Formic acid.
Solution C: 8 mL HPLC-grade water and 5 µL Formic acid.
Solution D: 6.4 mL HPLC-grade acetonitrile, 1.5 mL HPLC-grade water, and 5 µL Formic acid.
Formic Acid Solution: 99.9 mL HPLC-grade Methanol and 100 µL Formic acid.

steps.title: Construct Filter Columns
steps.instruction: Create custom filter columns using Empore disks and pipette tips.

substeps.instruction: Puncture holes in the center of 2.0mL (wash) and 1.5mL (collection) tube caps using a 3mm screwdriver.
Fit a 200µL unfiltered tip into each cap as a protector sheath.
Place a 10µL unfiltered tip in the wash tube sheath.
Punch 3 holes in an Empore 2240 filter disk with an 18-gauge needle and use compressed air to deposit the punches snugly into the 10µL tip.

steps.title: Column Activation and Peptide Binding
steps.instruction: Activate the filter column and bind the peptides.

substeps.instruction: Activate column by sequentially adding 75 µL of Buffer A, then 75 µL of Buffer D, then 75 µL of Buffer C, spinning each at 4,000 x g, 25°C for 30 seconds. Repeat the sequence once.
Decant wash tube and place column in the collection tube sheath.
Add 30 µg of peptide to the filter tip and spin at 4,000 x g, 25°C for 2 minutes.
Reapply eluate to the filter and spin again for 2 minutes; repeat once more.

steps.title: Peptide Elution and Final Preparation
steps.instruction: Wash and elute peptides, then prepare for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Wash tip with 75 µL Buffer C; spin at 4,000 x g, 25°C for 1 minute.
Transfer tip to the collection tube sheath.
Elute by adding 50 µL Buffer B (spin 1 min, 4,000 x g, 25°C), then 50 µL Buffer D (spin 1 min, 4,000 x g, 25°C). Keep eluates.
Transfer sample to a glass autosampler vial and bring total volume to 29µL using Formic Acid Solution.
Add 1µL Waters MassPREP™ Enolase digestion standard; vortex.
Store at -80°C or proceed to LC-MS/MS.

steps.title: Prepare Quality Control Samples
steps.instruction: Create intra-study and laboratory standards.

substeps.instruction: Prepare an intrastudy QC by transferring 1 µL from each sample into a single autosampler vial.
Prepare an enolase intra/inter laboratory standard at 25 fmol/µL.
